b:
"When the journey ends,
won't the fear
leave too?"

I hum
the lines

Today
the journey is
at a comma

New moulds,
new habits

A journey across the sea,
a car licence,
a book of poems

People
spotless
in the heart

If we do not want
any distance,
one day
a vast space
in life

The journey goes on
with old habits

In a life chased by death,
chasing after hearts
